vulkanturbo.options.title: Pyroclast Settings
vulkanturbo.options.enabled.tooltip: Master switch for all Pyroclast optimizations on the Vulkan backend.
vulkanturbo.options.asyncOcclusionCullin: Runs full and partial section occlusion BFS updates asynchronously off the render thread.
vulkanturbo.options.fastChunkPrep.toolti: Eliminates per-frame allocations and hash lookups in indirect terrain draw preparation, lighting, and meshing.
Writes ChunkSectionInfo instanced data directly into persistently mapped GPU ring buffers.
vulkanturbo.options.cacheVoxelBounds.too: Caches immutable VoxelShape bounding boxes across collision and shadow queries.
vulkanturbo.options.stateDedup.tooltip: Skips redundant Vulkan pipeline binds and scissor updates when already active.
vulkanturbo.options.normalCache.tooltip: Caches packed vertex normals across consecutive vertices sharing the same normal.
vulkanturbo.options.fastEntityRender.too: Eliminates per-entity, glyph, and particle allocations during model and geometry submission.
vulkanturbo.options.scopedBarriers.toolt: Replaces global ALL_COMMANDS pipeline barriers with stage- and access-scoped synchronization.
vulkanturbo.options.bufferViewCache.tool: Caches VkBufferView handles for TEXEL_BUFFER uniform bindings across draws.
vulkanturbo.options.autoVendorOptimizati: Automatically enables pipeline caching and optimal image layouts on AMD RDNA and Intel Arc GPUs.
vulkanturbo.options.pipelineCache.toolti: Persists VkPipelineCache blobs to disk across launches. Requires restart to reload cache on device init.
Tracks and transitions Vulkan images to optimal usage layouts instead of VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL.
vulkanturbo.options.verboseLogging.toolt: Logs detailed GPU probe and periodic runtime optimization statistics.
vulkanturbo.options.benchmark.tooltip: Logs frame-time percentile windows while in a world for performance measurement.
vulkanturbo.toast.error_click: Click or press F9 to view log
